faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Tech Cuisine
faq.subtitle: Quick answers about cost control, AI analysis, and how the platform works for professional kitchens.

items.question: Does Tech Cuisine offer a free trial?
items.answer: Yes. You start with 7 free uses to test recipe costing and analysis in practice.

items.question: What is a technical recipe sheet?
items.answer: A technical sheet (ficha técnica) is the professional standard for documenting a recipe: ingredients, purchase quantities, yield correction factors, unit costs, and the calculated cost per serving. Tech Cuisine builds and maintains these automatically.

items.question: What is a yield correction factor and why does it matter?
items.answer: When you buy 1 kg of a vegetable, you rarely use all of it — cleaning, trimming, and cooking create losses. The yield factor accounts for this: if an onion has a 0.8 yield, you only get 800 g of usable product from 1 kg purchased. Without this correction, your cost per serving is always understated.

items.question: How does Tech Cuisine calculate food cost percentage?
items.answer: Food Cost % = (Total Recipe Cost ÷ Selling Price) × 100. Tech Cuisine calculates your recipe cost per serving (with yield corrections applied), and lets you set your target margin to see what the selling price should be.

items.question: What is the menu matrix (BC matrix)?
items.answer: The BC matrix classifies each dish by two dimensions: popularity and profitability. Stars have both. Plowhorses are popular but low margin. Puzzles are profitable but rarely ordered. Dogs have low demand and low margin. Knowing where each dish sits tells you where to focus your menu engineering.

items.question: Can Tech Cuisine scale a recipe automatically?
items.answer: Yes. Enter the base yield (e.g. 4 portions) and the target yield (e.g. 80 portions) and every ingredient quantity, yield-corrected amount, and cost updates instantly.

items.question: Does the AI understand culinary terminology?
items.answer: Yes. The AI is trained to understand professional kitchen language: preparation methods, yield factors, ingredient synonyms, and standard units across different culinary traditions.

items.question: Can I track supplier prices over time?
items.answer: Price tracking and supplier management are features currently in development. The platform is built to support this from day one — early users will get access first.

items.question: Which languages does the platform support?
items.answer: Tech Cuisine is available in English and Portuguese.

items.question: Does it work on mobile?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is optimised for mobile browsers so you can cost recipes, check margins, and review your menu from anywhere — including the kitchen pass.

items.question: What types of businesses benefit most?
items.answer: Any food operation that needs to control cost: fine dining restaurants, casual dining, catering companies, hotel kitchens, ghost kitchens, and culinary schools. If you have a menu and a food cost problem, Tech Cuisine is built for you.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The price is not yet defined. The free tier includes 7 free uses to test recipe costing and analysis in practice.

items.question: What data do you store?
items.answer: Only what is needed to run the platform: your account information, recipe sheets, ingredient data, and usage history. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties.

items.question: Is Tech Cuisine only for Michelin-level restaurants?
items.answer: Not at all. The principles of food cost control apply to every professional kitchen — from a neighbourhood bistro to a stadium concession. The tools are designed to be practical for any kitchen managing real costs.

metadata.title: Tech Cuisine vs recipe apps, spreadsheets and ERPs — real recipe costing and menu engineering for Portugal
metadata.description: Compare Tech Cuisine with recipe apps, spreadsheets and generic management suites. See how real-cost recipe sheets, supplier price tracking and AI-powered menu engineering make the difference for professional kitchens in Portugal.

ComparePage.h1: Tech Cuisine and other kitchen tools — what's actually different?
ComparePage.lead: There are recipe apps. There is Excel. There are systems built for other markets. Tech Cuisine was built from the ground up for the professional Portuguese kitchen: shaped by the feedback of a renowned pastry chef and the demands of people who live behind the stove.

origin.title: Born inside a real kitchen
paragraphs: This was not a whiteboard idea. Tech Cuisine was built with direct feedback from a renowned pastry chef in Portugal — someone who knows the difference between gross and net yield, understands what it means when butter prices jump without warning, and knows that a costing error is not a slip, it is a bill that does not balance.

What shaped the product was reality: recipe sheets that calculate the true cost per portion, ingredients with yield factors, scaling without recalculating from memory, and a menu view that shows where the profit actually is before it is too late.

recipeApps.title: Recipe apps
recipeApps.context: Recipe apps handle the creative side well: inspiration, discovery, organizing preparations. They are the ideal starting point for home cooks or anyone exploring techniques.
recipeApps.focus: Tech Cuisine operates at a different layer: operations and financial viability. It calculates the real cost per portion with yield factors (what you buy vs what you actually use), scales recipes without losing precision, and ranks each dish by real margin — not just apparent popularity.

spreadsheets.title: Excel and spreadsheets
spreadsheets.context: Spreadsheets are powerful and flexible. Many kitchens rely on them for years because they work, they are free, and anyone can open a file.
spreadsheets.focus: The issue is not Excel — it is what Excel cannot calculate automatically: net ingredient yield, supplier price history, Food Cost Percentage per dish, and alerts when margins fall below sustainable levels. Tech Cuisine does all of this in real time, without manual macros.

genericStack.title: ERPs and global management suites
genericStack.context: There are robust management systems built for large-scale operations with multiple warehouses, franchises, and diversified markets. Serious tools for serious scale.
genericStack.focus: They were built for a different reality. Tech Cuisine was designed specifically for the suppliers, prices, and market dynamics of Portugal: seasonal, local, with raw materials that shift in price every week. No adapters, no forty-hour setup, no support team that does not know what a quenelle is.

faq.title: Questions from people who work in a kitchen

items.question: Isn't this just another recipe app with nice photos?
items.answer: No. Tech Cuisine was not built for inspiration — it was built for operations. The difference is in the recipe sheet with real cost per portion, yield factors per ingredient (what you buy vs what you actually use), precise scaling, and menu engineering with Food Cost Percentage. It is for people who need the numbers to work, not for those who want to save recipes.

items.question: I have used Excel for years. Why would I switch?
items.answer: Excel does what you tell it to — but it does not know that 1 kg of cauliflower yields 600 g of florets. It does not update when a supplier changes their price list. It does not automatically calculate the FCP for each dish or warn you when margins are at risk. Tech Cuisine does not replace your logic; it replaces the repetitive manual work that takes time away from the kitchen.

items.question: Supplier prices in Portugal change constantly. How does Tech Cuisine handle that?
items.answer: That is exactly what it was designed for. The price history per ingredient lets you track variation over time, anticipate increases, and make decisions before margins are compromised. When the cost of an ingredient rises, the impact on each dish and on the menu is calculated automatically.

items.question: What type of kitchen is Tech Cuisine for?
items.answer: For professional kitchens in Portugal that need real control: restaurants, pastry shops, catering operations, dark kitchens. Any operation where ingredient prices matter, recipes need to scale precisely, and the menu must be profitable — not just well-presented.

metadata.title: How Tech Cuisine came to be — a pastry chef, real costs and the kitchen that deserves serious tools
metadata.description: The story behind Tech Cuisine: recipe costing, ingredient prices, recipe scaling and purposeful AI — built from the feedback of a renowned pastry chef in Portugal.

AboutPage.lead: This is not another recipe app with pretty photos. It is a tool made for people who live behind the stove — where ingredient prices shift every week and a costing mistake can close a kitchen.

sections.title: The pressure that never reaches the plate
paragraphs: Shifts that start before dawn and end past midnight. Raw materials that jump in price without warning. Recipes scaled from memory at three in the afternoon with forty covers incoming. Waste that translates directly into lost margin.
Professional kitchens are among the most demanding environments in the world — and most of them are still managed with spreadsheets that do not know the difference between gross yield and net yield.

sections.title: The wrong tools are not on your level
paragraphs: There are recipe apps. There are generic spreadsheets. There are systems designed for markets with different scales and different currencies.

What is missing in Portugal — and in many markets — is something that speaks the real language of the kitchen: correction factors, cost per portion, supplier price history, one-click scalability. Not tricks. Not pretty dashboards that do not understand what a duck stock or a scallop yield actually means.

sections.title: Born from clear eyes
paragraphs: Tech Cuisine was built from a very concrete vision: that of a leading pastry chef in Portugal who, over many years, watched the same problem repeat itself. Exceptional recipes, boundless creativity — and cost management that fell behind because the available tools were not made for this industry.
That perspective shaped every product decision: what gets tracked, what gets calculated, what gets automated, and what stays in the hands of the professional.

sections.title: You are the hero of your kitchen
paragraphs: Tech Cuisine does not come to replace your instinct or your technique. It comes to handle what consumes time without creating value: calculating, converting, scaling, comparing prices, suggesting margins.

The challenge of running a viable kitchen is not just having a great recipe — it is knowing what it costs, what it yields, what you can charge, and what needs to change when the price of beef tenderloin rises 20%. Technology with purpose frees you for what only you can do.

sections.title: Value first. Invitation second.
paragraphs: Before asking anything of you, we want Tech Cuisine to give you something: clarity. A chef's or pastry chef's time is too scarce to waste on vague promises.
Try it. Log a recipe cost sheet. See what the real cost of a dish says about the price you charge. Only after you feel the value does it make sense to stay — and we hope you will.

sections.title: What guides us
paragraphs: We believe an honest tool answers the hard questions before they are asked — including "is this actually worth it?".
We believe the most effective message is the clearest, not the most elaborate — and that technology should serve a purpose, not impress.
We believe the strongest communities form around shared purpose: building kitchens that are better, more profitable, and more free.

section1.title: 1. Introduction and Scope
section1.content: Tech Cuisine ("Service") is operated by Daniel Fonseca da Silva, an independent worker in Portugal ("Provider", "we", "our" or "us"), and respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, process, and protect information when you use the Tech Cuisine service ("Service").
section1.complianceContent: This policy complies with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD), European GDPR, US state privacy laws including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA), the UK's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act, and applicable international data protection regulations.
section1.serviceOverviewContent: The Service provides a SaaS kitchen cost management platform, including technical recipe sheets, cost per serving calculations, ingredient yield factors, menu engineering, waste tracking, ingredient and supplier pricing, financial reports, and AI-powered analysis of recipes and kitchen operations.

subsection2.legalObligation: Legal Obligation (Article 6(1)(c)): Regulatory compliance and legal requirements
subsection2.sensitiveData: Sensitive Data (Article 9): When sensitive data such as gender is processed, we base it on explicit consent from the data subject

subsection3.serviceDelivery: Service Delivery: Providing the kitchen cost and menu management platform, technical recipe sheets, financial analyses, and reports
subsection3.aiProcessing: AI Processing: Use of Claude AI and ChatGPT for recipe analysis, cost calculation, pricing suggestions, and kitchen operational recommendations

subsection3.serviceImprovement: Service Improvement: Analyzing usage patterns to enhance features and functionality
subsection3.marketingAnalysis: Marketing and Analytics: Understanding user behavior and promoting relevant services
subsection3.legalCompliance: Legal Compliance: Meeting tax, regulatory, and law enforcement obligations

subsection1.title: AI Systems Used:
subsection1.contentAnalysis: Content Analysis: Processing recipe and ingredient data for relevance, quality, and cost accuracy
subsection1.jobScoring: Recipe and Cost Evaluation: Algorithmic analysis of technical sheets, yields, and margins for food cost optimization
subsection1.contextExpansion: Automatic Context Expansion: Enriching recipe and ingredient information with additional relevant data (e.g. market prices, measurement equivalences)
subsection1.recommendationGeneration: Recommendation Generation: Personalizing menu, pricing, and kitchen operations suggestions based on user data

section5.transparency: AI Transparency: AI processing involves analysis of user preferences, search history, and interaction patterns to improve recommendation accuracy. Users may request detailed explanations of AI decision-making processes that affect their service experience.

subsection2.dataProcessing: Data Processing Agreements: Comprehensive agreements with all international processors that include data protection obligations
subsection2.privacyShield: Privacy Shield Successors: Appropriate frameworks for US data transfers when available
subsection2.adequateProtection: Adequate Protection: Ensuring that recipient countries provide adequate levels of data protection equivalent to EU and Brazil standards

section7.userRights: User Rights Regarding Transfers: Users may request information about international transfers affecting their data and the safeguards protecting their information in foreign jurisdictions.

subsection1.accountData: Account Data: Retained while the account is active plus 30 days after closure

subsection1.legalCompliance: Legal Compliance Data: As required by applicable laws and regulations

subsection2.title: Automatic Deletion:
subsection2.content: We implement automated deletion processes to remove data after retention periods end. Users receive notification before automatic deletion when required by law. We collect and retain only data necessary for specified purposes and regularly review retention practices to minimize storage duration.

section13.content: Although our Service is available to all users, we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age without parental consent in compliance with COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act).
